subject.descriptionZh: 研究组织的战略、结构、人才、市场、会计、金融与科学决策。
subject.descriptionJa: 組織の戦略、構造、人材、市場、会計、ファイナンス、科学的意思決定を研究する分野。
subject.descriptionEn: The study of organizational strategy, structure, people, markets, accounting, finance, and scientific decision making.

Business-Administration.Strategy.subject: Business-Administration
Business-Administration.Strategy.descriptionZh: 研究竞争优势、企业定位、资源配置与长期发展方向。
Business-Administration.Strategy.descriptionJa: 競争優位、企業のポジショニング、資源配分、長期的な発展方向を扱う。
Business-Administration.Strategy.descriptionEn: Competitive advantage, organizational positioning, resource allocation, and long-term direction.

Business-Administration.Organization.subject: Business-Administration
Business-Administration.Organization.descriptionZh: 研究组织结构、制度、文化、权力与组织行为。
Business-Administration.Organization.descriptionJa: 組織構造、制度、文化、権力、組織行動を扱う。
Business-Administration.Organization.descriptionEn: Organizational structure, institutions, culture, power, and behavior.

Business-Administration.Human-Resource-M.subject: Business-Administration
Business-Administration.Human-Resource-M.descriptionZh: 研究人员招聘、配置、培养、评价、激励与劳动关系。
Business-Administration.Human-Resource-M.descriptionJa: 採用、配置、育成、評価、動機づけ、労使関係を扱う。
Business-Administration.Human-Resource-M.descriptionEn: Recruitment, staffing, development, evaluation, motivation, and employment relations.

Business-Administration.Marketing.subject: Business-Administration
Business-Administration.Marketing.descriptionZh: 研究消费者、市场分析、产品、定价、渠道、传播与品牌。
Business-Administration.Marketing.descriptionJa: 消費者、市場分析、製品、価格、流通、コミュニケーション、ブランドを扱う。
Business-Administration.Marketing.descriptionEn: Consumers, market analysis, products, pricing, distribution, communication, and brands.

Business-Administration.Accounting.subject: Business-Administration
Business-Administration.Accounting.descriptionZh: 研究财务报告、管理会计、审计、成本与企业绩效衡量。
Business-Administration.Accounting.descriptionJa: 財務報告、管理会計、監査、原価、企業業績の測定を扱う。
Business-Administration.Accounting.descriptionEn: Financial reporting, management accounting, auditing, costs, and organizational performance measurement.

Business-Administration.Finance.subject: Business-Administration
Business-Administration.Finance.descriptionZh: 研究企业融资、投资决策、资本结构、资产定价与风险管理。
Business-Administration.Finance.descriptionJa: 企業金融、投資意思決定、資本構成、資産価格、リスク管理を扱う。
Business-Administration.Finance.descriptionEn: Corporate financing, investment decisions, capital structure, asset pricing, and risk management.

Business-Administration.Management-Scien.subject: Business-Administration

Business-Administration.Management-Scien.descriptionJa: 定量モデル、最適化、シミュレーション、データ分析によって経営意思決定を支援する。
Business-Administration.Management-Scien.descriptionEn: Quantitative models, optimization, simulation, and data analysis for managerial decision making.
